title: In-game Trainer 0.4.0-beta.6 / Nexus framework and Apply diagnostics
body:
## 0.4.0-beta.6

Fixes an unreadable/stale target input being replaced with an old cached value. Apply now stops when the target cannot be read. The panel reports readiness, native-read, verification and save-stage failures with clearer diagnostics. Existing saloon/local-save checks remain in place.

**Framework dependency:** [UE4SS for FarFarWest — Nexus mod 2](https://www.nexusmods.com/farfarwest/mods/2?tab=files), player Main File **UE4SS-FarFarWest 3.0.1.1183 Frostburn, file 242**, by anro / AnroG772. Use the complete player package, including all its configuration and signatures; choose the player Main File rather than zDEV.

**Installation:** fully exit the game and privately back up **%LOCALAPPDATA%\FarFarWest\Saved\SaveGames** and existing mod Data. Install the complete Nexus framework beside FarFarWest-Win64-Shipping.exe at **<Steam game root>/FarFarWest/Binaries/Win64**. Extract **FFWTrainer-0.4.0-beta.6.zip** and copy the contents of **GameRoot** into the Steam game root. This beta.6 package installs only Mods/FFWTrainer and does not overwrite framework DLLs, configuration, mod lists or signatures. Preserve existing Data and fully restart.

[Full English install / upgrade / troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/ohhhhhhhhha/far-far-west-desktop-trainer/blob/main/INSTALL.en.md) · [中文安装指南](https://github.com/ohhhhhhhhha/far-far-west-desktop-trainer/blob/main/INSTALL.zh-CN.md)

**Verified scope:** 43/43 offline Lua test files passed. On the local Nexus 1183 setup, the user confirmed same-value Apply and a gold increase of 1 that persisted after returning to the title and re-entering the saloon. This does not certify every level field, multiplayer role or computer, or establish the cause of every earlier crash report.

Both ground-pickup and direct Joker modes, Halloween resources, magic levels and the native-menu total-point option remain available. No additional hotkeys were introduced.

---

目标输入读取失败或已过期时，不再提交缓存的旧数值；应用会停止并显示原因。补充就绪条件、原生读取、校验和保存阶段提示，保留酒馆及本人存档检查。

**框架依赖：** 使用上方 **Nexus mod 2 / 文件 242，UE4SS-FarFarWest 3.0.1.1183 Frostburn 玩家主文件**，完整保留配套配置和全部签名，不选 zDEV。

安装前完整退出游戏，私下备份 **%LOCALAPPDATA%\FarFarWest\Saved\SaveGames** 及已有 Mod Data。完整 Nexus 框架放入 **<Steam 游戏根目录>/FarFarWest/Binaries/Win64**。将 **beta.6** 运行 ZIP 的 **GameRoot 内部内容**复制到游戏根目录；本版只安装 Mods/FFWTrainer，不覆盖框架 DLL、配置、Mod 列表或签名。保留原 Data，更新后完整重启。

43/43 份离线 Lua 测试通过。本机 Nexus 1183 环境已由用户确认：同值应用通过，金币增加 1 后回标题重新进入酒馆仍保留。本次验收不涵盖全部等级字段、所有联机身份或每台电脑，也不代表所有旧崩溃反馈已完成归因。保留两种刷卡模式、活动资源、魔法等级和原菜单总点数解限，不新增按键。

旧版本附件保持不变。归档 beta.5 若用于 Nexus 框架，只复制其 Mods/FFWTrainer 子目录，不复制其旧签名；详见仓库兼容指南。附件不含玩家存档、Data 内容、日志或个人路径。
